summary.en: Disc Medicine reported that its Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in erythropoietic protoporphyria met all primary and secondary endpoints, with a 41.4% reduction in whole-blood metal-free PPIX versus placebo, and ended Q3 with approximately $683M in cash after a $486M October offering. Dogwood Therapeutics completed its Halneuron Phase 2b CINP trial (239 patients) with top-line results expected in November and closed a $5M private placement extending its runway to Q1 2027. Premarket futures show a mixed picture: S&P 500 futures are flat at +0.09% while Nasdaq-100 futures are down -0.81%, suggesting the prior session's broad rally is not being extended.
summary.zh: Disc Medicine（NASDAQ: IRON）报告其bitopertin治疗红细胞生成性原卟啉症的III期APOLLO试验达到全部主要和次要终点，全血无金属PPIX较安慰剂降低41.4%，第三季度末现金约$683M（含10月$486M增发）。Dogwood Therapeutics（Nasdaq: DWTX）完成Halneuron IIb期CINP试验（239例），顶线数据预计11月公布，并完成$5M私募将运营跑道延至2027年Q1。盘前期货表现分化：标普500期货持平（+0.09%），纳指100期货下跌-0.81%，前一交易日的普涨格局未见延续。

title.en: Disc Medicine: Phase 3 APOLLO trial of bitopertin in EPP meets all primary and secondary endpoints; Q3 cash ~$683M after $486M October offering
title.zh: Disc Medicine：bitopertin治疗EPP的III期APOLLO试验达到全部主要和次要终点；10月$486M增发后Q3末现金约$683M

impact.en: Bitopertin reduced whole-blood metal-free PPIX by 41.4% vs placebo (p<0.0001) and increased pain-free sunlight time by 12.2 hours in month 6 (p=0.0010). NDA resubmission is planned by end of 2026 with an FDA decision anticipated by mid-2027. The company also reported positive initial RESTORE-PV data for DISC-3405 in polycythemia vera and an end-of-Phase 2 FDA meeting for selcodebart in myelofibrosis anemia planned by year-end.
impact.zh: Bitopertin较安慰剂降低全血无金属PPIX 41.4%（p<0.0001），第6个月无痛日照时间增加12.2小时（p=0.0010）。公司计划2026年底前重新提交NDA，FDA决定预计2027年中。此外，DISC-3405治疗真性红细胞增多症的RESTORE-PV研究初步数据积极，selcodebart治疗骨髓纤维化贫血的II期结束FDA会议计划年底前举行。

bullish: Phase 3 APOLLO success in EPP with statistically significant co-primary endpoints
Cash runway extended into 2030 with ~$683M on hand

macroRisk.en: FDA regulatory timeline for NDA resubmission and approval remains a binary risk; no approval is guaranteed by mid-2027.
macroRisk.zh: NDA重新提交及审批的FDA监管时间线仍为二元风险；2027年中获批并非确定。

title.en: Dogwood Therapeutics: Q3 net loss $4.9M; Halneuron Phase 2b CINP trial completed (239 patients), top-line data expected November; $5M private placement closed
title.zh: Dogwood Therapeutics：Q3净亏损$4.9M；Halneuron IIb期CINP试验完成（239例），顶线数据预计11月公布；$5M私募完成

impact.en: Q3 2026 revenue was $0.1M (first payment under PRIDCor License Agreement); R&D expense was $3.3M vs $14.5M a year earlier (prior year included $12.0M IPR&D charge). Net loss was $4.9M ($0.14/share) vs $15.7M ($8.20/share) in Q3 2025. Cash of $4.9M plus the $5M placement from Sealbond Limited (CK Life Sciences subsidiary) provides runway through Q1 2027.
impact.zh: 2026年Q3收入$0.1M（PRIDCor许可协议首笔付款）；研发费用$3.3M，上年同期$14.5M（上年含$12.0M IPR&D费用）。净亏损$4.9M（每股$0.14），上年同期$15.7M（每股$8.20）。$4.9M在手现金加上Sealbond Limited（CK Life Sciences子公司）$5M私募，运营跑道至2027年Q1。

bullish: Phase 2b CINP trial completed with top-line results expected in November 2026
bearish: Cash runway only extends to Q1 2027, creating near-term funding dependency

macroRisk.en: As a pre-revenue biotech with limited cash, execution risk on the Phase 2b readout and subsequent Phase 3 funding is elevated.
macroRisk.zh: 作为无收入、现金有限的生物科技公司，IIb期数据读出及后续III期融资的执行风险较高。

note.en: The prior session's broad rally (Dow +3.05%, S&P +1.59%) came with sector divergence—semis -3%, energy -4.75%—and this morning's futures suggest stalling. S&P 500 futures are flat at +0.09% while Nasdaq-100 futures are down -0.81%, which may indicate the prior day's breadth was value-led rather than a sustained tech bid. The 10-year yield is stable at 4.904% (+1bp) and the dollar marginally firmer at 101.63 (+0.12%), neither strongly supportive. Gold's +1.5% rise could reflect hedging, though the driver is unconfirmed. I lean toward a cautious open: the split between Dow futures (+0.68%) and Nasdaq futures (-0.81%) suggests rotation, not unified risk-on. Watch whether Nasdaq futures stabilize above the prior close in the first 30 minutes; failure would weaken the breadth thesis.
note.zh: 前一交易日大盘普涨（道指+3.05%、标普+1.59%）但板块分化明显——半导体-3%、能源-4.75%——今晨期货显示动能正在停滞。标普500期货基本持平（+0.09%），而纳指100期货下跌-0.81%，这可能表明前一日的广度是由价值股驱动而非科技股持续买盘。10年期美债收益率稳定在4.904%（+1bp），美元指数微升至101.63（+0.12%），均不构成明显支撑。黄金上涨1.5%可能反映对冲需求，但驱动因素未确认。我倾向于谨慎开盘：道指期货（+0.68%）与纳指期货（-0.81%）的分化暗示轮动而非统一风险偏好。关注纳指期货能否在前30分钟站稳前收盘价上方；若未能企稳，则前一日的广度逻辑将被削弱。
